scope: Candidate build and local installation wrapper adjudication; original evidence remains preserved

candidate_build.result: Plugin build, binary/actual ABI checks and licensed Stata bias fixture passed. The unit-test compilation failed because the source tar omitted a synthetic include_str CSV.
candidate_build.resolution: Add only the hashed synthetic fixture supplement. Corrected check 7774704 passed; production source and binaries stayed unchanged.

installation.first: Staged-path guard returned Stata rc 498 because the wrapper directory also contained a plugin. A receipt-writing attribute name was wrong independently.
installation.resolution: Use a fixture-only directory and the existing process_returncode field. The unchanged Stata fixture passed with explicit rc 0 and terminal sentinel.

local_identity_harness.first: System Python lacked numpy and attempted a bytecode-cache directory outside the sandbox; no SCC job was affected.
local_identity_harness.resolution: Used the existing scientific virtual environment with bytecode disabled; synthetic equality and two refusals passed before submission.

collection.event: Direct-call timing CSVs included finite-control coefficient rows; they were removed from local files and the new receipt immediately on discovery.
collection.resolution: The final collector accepts only clock, bias_diagnostics, bias_support, feppml_runtime and feppml_threads matrices. No raw captures or FE coefficient arrays were copied.
